question.problem:
Given that the random variable $X∼B(50,0.58),$ use the normal approximation to the binomial distribution to approximate $P(25\le X\le 30).$ Give your final answer to three decimal places. *Hint: The data below is taken from the table of values of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z)$ for the standard normal distribution. *
$z$$\,0.07\,$$\,0.08\,$$\,0.09\,$
$\,-1.3\,$ $\,0.0854\,$ $\,0.0838\,$ $\,0.0823\,$
$\,-1.2\,$ $\,0.1020\,$ $\,0.1003\,$ $\,0.0985\,$
$\,-1.1\,$ $\,0.1210\,$ $\,0.1190\,$ $\,0.1170\,$
$z$$\,0.02\,$$\,0.03\,$$\,0.04\,$
$\,0.4\,$ $\,0.6628\,$ $\,0.6664\,$ $\,0.6700\,$
$\,0.5\,$ $\,0.6985\,$ $\,0.7019\,$ $\,0.7054\,$
$\,0.6\,$ $\,0.7324\,$ $\,0.7357\,$ $\,0.7389\,$
question.worked_solution:
Given a binomial random variable $X∼B(n,p),$ if 

- $np>5,$ and

- $n(1-p)>5,$

we can approximate $X$ as a normal random variable $Y$ with mean $\mu =np$ and variance ${\sigma }^{2}=np(1-p),$ that is, 

$$
Y∼N(np,np(1-p)).
$$

Here, we have $n=50$ and $p=0.58.$ Therefore, 

$$
\begin{aligned}np & =50\cdot 0.58 \\  & =29 \\  & >5\,✓ \\ n(1-p) & =50\cdot (1-0.58) \\  & =21 \\  & >5.\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

So, we can approximate our binomial random variable $X$ with a normal random variable $Y$ with mean

$$
\mu =np=(50)(0.58)=29
$$

and variance

$$
{\sigma }^{2}=np(1-p)=(50)(0.58)(1-0.58)=12.18.
$$

That is, we can approximate $X$ by $Y∼N(29,12.18).$

Now, we can estimate the desired probability $P(25\le X\le 30).$ Using a continuity correction, we have

$$
P(25\le X\le 30)≈P(24.5\le Y\le 30.5).
$$

To compute this probability, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(24.5\le Y\le 30.5) & =P(\frac{24.5-29}{\sqrt{12.18}}\le Z\le \frac{30.5-29}{\sqrt{12.18}}) \\  & ≈P(-1.29\le Z\le 0.43) \\  & =P(Z\le 0.43)-P(Z<-1.29) \\  & =P(Z\le 0.43)-P(Z\le -1.29) \\  & =Φ(0.43)-Φ(-1.29) \\  & =0.6664-0.0985 \\  & =0.5679\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
P(25\le X\le 30)≈0.568.
$$

Note: Using a software package for the approximation gives a probability of $0.5646.$
